title: Maximum Difference Between Increasing Elements
summary: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums of size n, find the maximum value of nums[j] - nums[i] where 0 <= i < j < n and nums[i] < nums[j].
statement: Given a 0-indexed integer array nums of size n, find the maximum value of nums[j] - nums[i] where 0 <= i < j < n and nums[i] < nums[j]. Return this maximum difference. If no such i and j exist, return -1.
constraints: Choose i<j with nums[i]<nums[j] and maximize nums[j]-nums[i].
Return -1 if no qualifying pair exists.
hints: For each later endpoint, the best earlier partner is the smallest value seen so far.
Scan once, updating the answer before incorporating the current value into the prefix minimum.
If x>minimum maximize x-minimum; then minimum=min(minimum,x).
The prefix invariant supplies the largest possible difference ending at each index, and maximizing those covers every valid pair.
